title: L3 runtime vs oracle verdict match
description: Whether the runtime verdict matched the verifier's oracle verdict. match=true is the security outcome; match=false is an L3 failure class.
x-schema-changelog: v1: runtime_decision enum was ALLOW|DENY|ERROR and reference_decision was ALLOW|DENY.

v2: adds INVALID to both decision enums for verification-only scenarios (integrity verification: a tampered ledger detected by independent chain re-computation — L3-AUD-002, THREAT-018), matching l3-plan.schema.json v2, l3-runtime-verdict.schema.json v2 and claim_gate P1. l3_claim remains const:true — this schema describes a CLAIMED bundle, and no change here weakens that.
